_notes.about: Lesson 3 in English (en and en-GB, which has its own keyboard). From the lesson plan "Typing Game Sentence Bank: Lessons 2-13". The id is the lesson's scoreboard: never change it.
_notes.intro: Page 1, before the keys: anything that doesn't fit on Page 2 (lesson 1: "what is touch typing?"). Leave it out and the lesson starts at the new keys. "title" and "paragraphs"; in a paragraph, **bold** and [E] (a key drawn as a key: [space], [;], [Tab] ...). "picture": "hands" (the default: the hands over the lesson's keyboard), "none", or a picture file in images/ (with "pictureAlt", what it shows). With "hands": "reach" sends fingers to keys ({"lm": "e", "rm": "i"}: lp lr lm li, rp rr rm ri; keys "e", ";", "ShiftL", "ShiftR" ...; the others stay home), and "keys" says which keys show: "letters" (the default), "shift", "symbols" or "all".
_notes.hideHand: "left", "right" or "none": that hand isn't drawn on Page 2, and its column of new keys isn't listed.
_notes.sentenceLists: Up to four lists: name (shown above the typing box, or ""), count (how many to pick at random each attempt; 0 = unused) and sentences. Use real words, and only keys taught so far. Lesson 1 has no end mark because ";" hasn't been taught. Write ⇥ for the Tab key and ↵ for Enter.

title: Lesson 3: E and I

intro.title: Leaving the home row
paragraphs: Until now every key has been on the home row, right under your fingers. From this lesson on, some keys are a reach away: a finger leaves the home row, presses the key, and comes straight back.
**Only the finger that needs the key moves.** The others stay resting on the home row, so your hands always know where they are.
Your middle fingers go first: the left one reaches up from [D] to [E], and the right one from [K] to [I].
If you lose your place, feel for the bumps on [F] and [J] and start again from the home row.

advice: [E] is just above [D]. Reach up with your left middle finger, press [E], and bring the finger straight back to [D].
[I] is just above [K]. Reach up with your right middle finger, press [I], and bring it straight back to [K].
Keep your other fingers resting on the home row while one finger reaches.
